cls.name: MaterialCategory
cls.description: A class of material the network moves. Sole-source risk is a property of a category, not of a plant, which is why it needs to be its own class.

relations_in.name: carriesCategory
relations_in.description: A material flow carries one material category.

relations_in.name: produces
relations_in.description: A plant is qualified to produce a material category. 11 plant-category pairs across 8 categories.

native.name: Material Category
native.description: A class of material the network moves. Sole-source risk is a property of a category, not of a plant, which is why it needs to be its own class. In the supply chain model: A Material Flow carries a Material Category (N:1). A Plant produces a Material Category (N:N). Source: Supply Chain Ontology app, SAP_SUPPLY_CHAIN.ONTOLOGY.
